content: Noah Nanatun Wawan Agirin
Atonio on Noah nanatun fifirig orot wabis: Shem, Ham a Japheth. Atonio fifirig ton on sareu gagamin igat gibunai on nanatus sirat.
Japheth Nanatun Wawan Agirin
Japheth nanatun fifirig orot wabis on Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech a Tiras.
Gomer nanatun wawan agirin on Ashkenaz, Ripahath a Togarmah.
Javan nanatun wawan agirin on Elishah, Spain, Cyprus a Rhodes;
atonio osi dam warar on tore a nua ai nan simama. Osi min Japheth nanatun wawan agirin an dam on dam ta ta a tafanam sigaraba sanasi sima ato osi engon on fonas ta ta sibi kakafun.
Ham Nanatun Wawan Agirin
Ham nanatun fifirig orot wabis on Cush, Egypt, Libya a Canaan.
Cush nanatun wawan agirin on Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah a Sabteca. Raamah nanatun wawan agirin on Sheba a Dedan.
Cush natun orot irat wabin Nimrod, on orot ainau inat orot faiwarin bag imatar, i yo igagam tafanam ibo.
BADA an baibais emon on inat masono bo am an orot gagamin imatar, on mes sabu sebi kakafun sau, “Om orot iyafan Nimrod ba on unnat regai bo am an orot gagamin bag un matar.”
Ainau on Nimrod mafam gagamis ton on i kakaifaren; Babylon, Erech a Akkad. Osi min Babylonia tafanam amonai.
Nimrod on Babylonia tafanam emon on inai Assyria nan mafam gagamis i goyon, osi mafam gagamis min Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
a Resen, on Nineveh a mafam gagamin Calah basunai.
Ato Egypt nanatun wawan agirin on Lydia, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh,
Pathrus, Casluh a Crete. Philistia sabu on Crete emon sinat.
Canaan nanatun orot wabis on Sidon a Heth.
Canaan on eb wawan agirin on Jebus, Amor, Girbash,
Hivi, Ark a Sini,
Arvad, Zemar a Hamath. On gibunai osi Canaan dam kakaita kakaita on sisonag sinai efan ta ta nan sima.

Canaan an tafanam an farat on Sidon mafam ibosuruf au gorof na inai Gerar mafam farat nan igat, on min Gaza mafam bisinai. Ato osi asi tafanam an farat turin min nan ibosuruf men au wera matan na inai au mafam Sodom a Gomorrah, Adamah, a Zeboiim nan igat on min Lasha efan bisinai.
Atonio on Ham nanatun wawan agirin. Osi dam kakaita kakaita on sinai tafanam ta ta nan sima ato osi dam min asi dura ta ta nan sibi kakafun.
Shem Nanatun Wawan Agirin
Shem on Japheth tuan ainau orot, on an dam warar on Hebrew yangan.
Shem nanatun orot wabis on Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud a Aram on osi asi dam iwabis.
Aram wawan agirin on Uz, Hul, Gether a Meshech yangan.
Arphaxad taman on Shelah ato on taman on Eber.

Eber on nanatun orot ruam: Fifi orot tani wabin on Peleg, yabin Peleg irat imama an werai on sabu on tafanamai simama on sikuseb mabis mabis sinai. Ato on wab Peleg an yabin min “Sikuseb.” Ato Peleg tain tani wabin on Joktan.
Joktan nanatun wawan agirin on Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
Ophir, Havilah a Jobab. Atonio osi engon on Joktan nanatun orot wawan agirin wat.
Ato osi dam on tafanam Mesha farat nan simama on inai Sephar nan igat na au wera matan oyau oyau tafanamai nan.
Atonio on Shem nanatun wawan agirin. On dam kakaita kakaita on tafanam ta ta nan sima ato osi engon min asi dura ta ta nan sibi kakafun.

Atonio osi dam warar wab kakaita kakaita, asi tafanam asi tafanam ai simama, osi engon on Noah nanatun wawan agirin wat. Sareu gagamin igat gibunai, Noah nanatun wawan agirin on sisonag sinai tafanam ta ta engon ibonu.
